note: Faithful executable import of the THA Companion Benchmark 100 v1.0. Wording is preserved verbatim from the source document; no benchmark meaning was changed. Questions run through the one Companion seam (conversationGateway.processUserTurn) only — see docs/intelligence/benchmark/BENCHMARK_AUTOMATION.md. Per-question household assignment, correctAnswerType, and scoring expectation records are intentionally NOT authored here (out of INTQ3 scope; owned by the execution/scoring workstreams).

gradeScale.A: Excellent now. Complete, useful, grounded, and human-satisfactory.
gradeScale.B: Good now. Minor gaps or polish needed.
gradeScale.C: Partial. Useful but incomplete, brittle, or dependent on missing context.
gradeScale.D: Weak. Some route or data may exist, but the user experience is poor.
gradeScale.F: Fail. Missing, misleading, generic, or not routed.
gradeScale.TBC: To be completed — Claude prediction / actual result recorded during execution (INTQ3 run).

maturityHorizons.launch: What paying families should reasonably expect before public release. Primary release gate.
maturityHorizons.y1: Stronger product with richer data, more complete retrieval, and more useful guidance. Near-term roadmap target.
maturityHorizons.y2: Mature household intelligence with deeper planning, nutrition, and adaptation. Strategic product target.
maturityHorizons.y3: Best-in-class family nutrition Companion. Category leadership target.
maturityHorizons.y5: Category-defining personalised household nutrition platform. Long-range product vision.
maturityHorizons.y10: Trusted family health-nutrition operating system, still not a doctor and still honest about gaps. North-star vision.
